name: Lohen
title: Sharpened Arrowhead
description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius' Fifth Company. Lohen loves and lives for battling, always raring to go against tough opponents that put his fighting skills to the test.

skillTalents.name: Spear of Favonius - Broken Oath
skillTalents.description: Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes. Charged Attack consumes stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way. Plunging Attack strikes the ground from mid-air, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Unforeseen Strike
skillTalents.description: Lohen enters the Masterstroke mode. In this state, his Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks deal Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by other elemental infusions. Hitting enemies with Normal or Charged Attacks grants Joy, which can be consumed to unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul.

skillTalents.name: Manifest Judgment
skillTalents.description: Lohen consumes all Will to Win stacks to deal multiple instances of Cryo DMG. The DMG of this Elemental Burst increases based on the amount of Will to Win consumed.

passiveTalents.name: Moratorium on Questioning
passiveTalents.description: Enhances Lohen's Masterstroke combat flow after using Unforeseen Strike.

passiveTalents.name: Flippant Masterpiece
passiveTalents.description: Improves the damage potential of Lohen's special Elemental Skill effects.

passiveTalents.name: Unhealing Thorn
passiveTalents.description: Provides an exploration utility effect outside combat.

passiveTalents.name: When the Mood Strikes
passiveTalents.description: Provides an additional utility effect tied to Lohen's adventuring style.

constellations.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
constellations.description: Improves Lohen's combat damage during his enhanced state.

constellations.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Unforeseen Strike by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
constellations.description: Adds a further enhancement to Lohen's Masterstroke interactions.

constellations.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious - Supreme Joy
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Manifest Judgment by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
constellations.description: Further improves Lohen's Will to Win and finishing damage.
